versions.changelog:
golang-continuous-integration v1.4.0

- Updated SKILL.md metadata: compatibility now explicitly includes Codex, and version bumped to 1.4.0.
- Removed skill-card.md from the project.

Version 1.3.1

- Added explicit dependency installation instructions for GoReleaser and gh CLI in the documentation.
- Updated metadata: incremented version to 1.3.1 and included npm install instructions for broader compatibility.
- Improved SKILL.md with a dedicated "Dependencies" section for easier setup guidance.
- Removed the outdated skill-card.md file.

- Updated SKILL.md for improved clarity and conciseness, including a revised description and streamlined instructions.
- Bumped metadata version to 1.3.0.
- No workflow logic changes; documentation and metadata updates only.

- Added AI-powered code review integration instructions, including support for Claude Code and Copilot.
- New workflow file for Claude-based PR code review automation.
- Updated documentation to include guidance on AI review tools under a new "AI Review" stage in the Quick Reference.
- Improved clarity around using the latest stable major version for GitHub Actions.
- Minor documentation refinements across pipeline security, release, and dependency update sections.

- Bump version to 1.1.2 in SKILL.md metadata.
- Add AskUserQuestion to allowed-tools list to enable interactive queries.
- No user-facing behavioral changes.

- Bumped skill metadata version from 1.1.0 to 1.1.1 in SKILL.md.
- No functional or instructional changes; metadata only.

Version 1.1.0

- Expanded documentation with a comprehensive quick reference table of CI/CD stages and tools for Go projects.
- Added detailed setup and best practices for testing (including race detection, test shuffling, and code coverage enforcement).
- Clarified integration test and linting requirements, including configuration for golangci-lint.
- Enhanced security section with recommendations for SAST tools and CodeQL configuration.
- Updated dependency management guidance with Dependabot/auto-merge and Renovate comparisons.
- Included security notes on workflow permissions and repository protection.
- Provided release automation instructions using GoReleaser, with security-focused tagging rules.
